description: Shrink a PDF from freedailypro. Default aims for about 50% smaller: tidies structure first (text untouched), then shrinks pictures only as much as needed. level: auto (default), medium, strong. targetFileSize (such as 2MB or 500KB) is the size to end at, for auto; default is half the original.

level.description: The level to apply or assume. One of: auto, medium, strong.

targetFileSize.description: The target file size to reach.

name: pdf_compress
